topics.headline: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing
topics.summary_short: Iterative reference-conditioned image editing can introduce grid-like and granular textures, commonly described as digital ripple. We present Mi-Ripple, a diagnosis-guided restoration workflow that suppresses this digital ripple while protecting image structure.
topics.why_it_matters: This research paper surfaced across 1 independent source(s).

evidence.title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing

topics.headline_zh: Mi-Ripple：修复因 AI 迭代编辑而退化的图像
topics.summary_short_zh: 以参考图像为条件的迭代图像编辑可能引入网格状和颗粒状纹理，通常称为“数字波纹”。我们提出 Mi-Ripple，一套由诊断引导的修复流程，可在保留图像结构的同时抑制此类数字波纹。
